answer: Agents bond stake before an epoch and commit to a polynomial whose evaluations bind each Semaphore identity to its rate-limit nullifier. Zero-knowledge proofs verify compliant messages without exposing identity. Reusing a nullifier for duplicate messages exposes distinct Shamir shares of the private key; interpolation reveals the key, allowing the breach to be verified and collateral slashed immediately. Juniper, copper, and opal may label public test vectors, never secrets.
